title: Automatic Distancing from Nearby players V2 by Maxx
script:
--[[
    ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
    ║                    DISTANCING BY MAXX                         ║
    ║          Advanced AI Distance Keeping with Draggable GUI      ║
    ║               Supports PC (Mouse) & Mobile (Touch)            ║
    ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local CONFIG = {
    DETECTION_RADIUS = 20,
    FLEE_RADIUS = 8,
    MOVE_SPEED = 24,
    SMOOTHING_FACTOR = 0.15,
    ROTATION_SMOOTHING = 0.1,
    PATHFIND_TIMEOUT = 0.8,
    JUMP_COOLDOWN = 0.5,
}

local isEnabled = false
local currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local lastPathfindTime = 0
local lastJumpTime = 0
local currentWaypoints = {}
local currentWaypointIndex = 1
local bodyVelocity = nil
local bodyGyro = nil

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "DistancingGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

GlowOrb2.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.5, 0)
GlowOrb2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.3, 0)

local GlowCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")

ToggleTrack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)

ToggleTrack.Parent = ToggleContainer

KnobGlow.Name = "KnobGlow"

local KnobGlowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 145)
StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Text = "⚡ Status: DISABLED"
StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
StatusLabel.TextSize = 16
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
StatusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
StatusLabel.Parent = ContentFrame

local ToggleOnSound = Instance.new("Sound")
ToggleOnSound.Name = "ToggleOnSound"
ToggleOnSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6042053626"
ToggleOnSound.Volume = 0.6
ToggleOnSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.1
ToggleOnSound.Parent = ScreenGui

local ToggleOffSound = Instance.new("Sound")
ToggleOffSound.Name = "ToggleOffSound"
ToggleOffSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6042053626"
ToggleOffSound.Volume = 0.5
ToggleOffSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.85
ToggleOffSound.Parent = ScreenGui

local dragging = false
local dragInput = nil
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

local function updateDragPosition(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale,
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPos.Y.Scale,
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or 
       input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local absolutePos = ToggleTrack.AbsolutePosition
        local absoluteSize = ToggleTrack.AbsoluteSize
        local inputPos = input.Position
        
        if inputPos.X >= absolutePos.X and 
           inputPos.X <= absolutePos.X + absoluteSize.X and
           inputPos.Y >= absolutePos.Y and 
           inputPos.Y <= absolutePos.Y + absoluteSize.Y then
            return
        end
        
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or 
       input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput then
        updateDragPosition(input)
    end
end)

local function setupBodyMovers()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end
    
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
    
    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "DistancingVelocity"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bodyVelocity.P = 1250
    bodyVelocity.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    
    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "DistancingGyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bodyGyro.P = 3000
    bodyGyro.D = 100
    bodyGyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    
    return true
end

local function cleanupBodyMovers()
    if bodyVelocity then 
        bodyVelocity:Destroy() 
        bodyVelocity = nil
    end
    if bodyGyro then 
        bodyGyro:Destroy() 
        bodyGyro = nil
    end
end

local function toggleAI()
    isEnabled = not isEnabled
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    
    if isEnabled then
        setupBodyMovers()
        
        TweenService:Create(ToggleKnob, tweenInfo, {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0.5, -16),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        }):Play()
        
        TweenService:Create(ToggleTrack, tweenInfo, {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120)
        }):Play()
        
        TweenService:Create(TrackStroke, tweenInfo, {
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 140)
        }):Play()
        
        StatusLabel.Text = "⚡ Status: ACTIVE"
        TweenService:Create(StatusLabel, tweenInfo, {
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 140)
        }):Play()
        
        ToggleOnSound:Play()
    else
        cleanupBodyMovers()
        
        TweenService:Create(ToggleKnob, tweenInfo, {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -16),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
        }):Play()
        
        TweenService:Create(ToggleTrack, tweenInfo, {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)
        }):Play()
        
        TweenService:Create(TrackStroke, tweenInfo, {
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100)
        }):Play()
        
        StatusLabel.Text = "⚡ Status: DISABLED"
        TweenService:Create(StatusLabel, tweenInfo, {
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
        }):Play()
        
        ToggleOffSound:Play()
        
        currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        currentWaypoints = {}
    end
end

ToggleTrack.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or 
       input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        toggleAI()
    end
end)

local gradientAngle = 0
local glowPhase = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    gradientAngle = (gradientAngle + dt * 15) % 360
    MainGradient.Rotation = gradientAngle
    
    glowPhase = glowPhase + dt
    
    local glow1X = 0.25 + math.sin(glowPhase * 0.8) * 0.15
    local glow1Y = 0.2 + math.cos(glowPhase * 0.6) * 0.1
    GlowOrb.Position = UDim2.new(glow1X, 0, glow1Y, 0)
    GlowOrb.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65 + math.sin(glowPhase * 2) * 0.1
    
    local glow2X = 0.45 + math.cos(glowPhase * 0.7) * 0.12
    local glow2Y = 0.35 + math.sin(glowPhase * 0.9) * 0.08
    GlowOrb2.Position = UDim2.new(glow2X, 0, glow2Y, 0)
    GlowOrb2.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7 + math.cos(glowPhase * 1.5) * 0.1
    
    TitleGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(glowPhase * 2) * 0.3, 0)
end)

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil, math.huge end
    
    local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return nil, math.huge end
    
    local myPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position
    local nearestPlayer = nil
    local nearestDistance = math.huge
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local otherCharacter = player.Character
            if otherCharacter then
                local otherHRP = otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if otherHRP then
                    local distance = (myPosition - otherHRP.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < nearestDistance then
                        nearestDistance = distance
                        nearestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestPlayer, nearestDistance
end

local function isPathBlocked(origin, direction, distance)
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return false end
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction.Unit * distance, raycastParams)
    return result ~= nil, result
end

local function findBestEscapeDirection(myPos, threatPos)
    local baseDirection = (myPos - threatPos)
    baseDirection = Vector3.new(baseDirection.X, 0, baseDirection.Z)
    
    if baseDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        baseDirection = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
    else
        baseDirection = baseDirection.Unit
    end
    
    local testAngles = {0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75, 100, -100, 130, -130, 160, -160}
    local bestDirection = baseDirection
    local bestScore = -math.huge
    local needsJump = false
    
    for _, angle in ipairs(testAngles) do
        local rad = math.rad(angle)
        local testDir = Vector3.new(
            baseDirection.X * math.cos(rad) - baseDirection.Z * math.sin(rad),
            0,
            baseDirection.X * math.sin(rad) + baseDirection.Z * math.cos(rad)
        )
        
        local lowBlocked = isPathBlocked(myPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), testDir, 5)
        local midBlocked = isPathBlocked(myPos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), testDir, 5)
        local highBlocked = isPathBlocked(myPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), testDir, 5)
        
        local score = 100 - math.abs(angle)
        
        if not lowBlocked then
            score = score + 60
        elseif not midBlocked then
            score = score + 30
            needsJump = true
        elseif not highBlocked then
            score = score + 10
        else
            score = score - 150
        end
        
        local dotProduct = testDir:Dot(baseDirection)
        score = score + dotProduct * 25
        
        if score > bestScore then
            bestScore = score
            bestDirection = testDir
            if not lowBlocked then
                needsJump = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    return bestDirection.Unit, needsJump
end

local function shouldJumpOverObstacle(myPos, direction)
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return false end
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
    
    local lowHit = workspace:Raycast(myPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), direction.Unit * 3, raycastParams)
    
    if lowHit then
        local highCheck = workspace:Raycast(myPos + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), direction.Unit * 3, raycastParams)
        if not highCheck then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

local pathfindingAgent = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
    AgentRadius = 2,
    AgentHeight = 5,
    AgentCanJump = true,
    AgentJumpHeight = 7,
    AgentMaxSlope = 45,
    Costs = { Water = 100 }
})

local function usePathfindingEscape(myPos, threatPos)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    
    local escapeDir = (myPos - threatPos)
    escapeDir = Vector3.new(escapeDir.X, 0, escapeDir.Z)
    
    if escapeDir.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        escapeDir = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
    else
        escapeDir = escapeDir.Unit
    end
    
    local targetPos = myPos + escapeDir * 15
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        pathfindingAgent:ComputeAsync(myPos, targetPos)
    end)
    
    if success and pathfindingAgent.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        currentWaypoints = pathfindingAgent:GetWaypoints()
        currentWaypointIndex = 2
        lastPathfindTime = tick()
        return true
    end
    
    return false
end

local function applyMovement(direction, shouldJump, dt)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not humanoidRootPart then return end
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    if not bodyVelocity or not bodyVelocity.Parent then
        setupBodyMovers()
        return
    end
    
    if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        targetVelocity = direction.Unit * CONFIG.MOVE_SPEED
    else
        targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    
    currentVelocity = currentVelocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, CONFIG.SMOOTHING_FACTOR)
    
    if currentVelocity.Magnitude > 0.1 then
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(10000, 0, 10000)
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(currentVelocity.X, 0, currentVelocity.Z)
    else
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    
    if shouldJump and (tick() - lastJumpTime) > CONFIG.JUMP_COOLDOWN then
        if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            lastJumpTime = tick()
        end
    end
end

local function faceTarget(targetPlayer)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetCharacter = targetPlayer.Character
    
    if not humanoidRootPart or not targetCharacter then return end
    
    local targetHRP = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return end
    
    if not bodyGyro or not bodyGyro.Parent then
        setupBodyMovers()
        return
    end
    
    local lookDir = (targetHRP.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position)
    lookDir = Vector3.new(lookDir.X, 0, lookDir.Z)
    
    if lookDir.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
    bodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(humanoidRootPart.Position, humanoidRootPart.Position + lookDir)
end

local function disableFacing()
    if bodyGyro and bodyGyro.Parent then
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
end

local function stopMovement()
    targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    
    currentVelocity = currentVelocity:Lerp(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.2)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not isEnabled then
        stopMovement()
        return
    end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    
    if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid then return end
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    local myPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position
    local nearestPlayer, distance = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if nearestPlayer and distance <= CONFIG.DETECTION_RADIUS then
        local targetCharacter = nearestPlayer.Character
        if not targetCharacter then return end
        
        local targetHRP = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not targetHRP then return end
        
        local threatPosition = targetHRP.Position
        
        if distance <= CONFIG.FLEE_RADIUS then
            disableFacing()
            
            local escapeDirection, needsJump = findBestEscapeDirection(myPosition, threatPosition)
            
            local directPathBlocked = isPathBlocked(
                myPosition + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
                escapeDirection,
                4
            )
            
            if directPathBlocked then
                if tick() - lastPathfindTime > CONFIG.PATHFIND_TIMEOUT then
                    usePathfindingEscape(myPosition, threatPosition)
                end
                
                if #currentWaypoints > 0 and currentWaypointIndex <= #currentWaypoints then
                    local waypoint = currentWaypoints[currentWaypointIndex]
                    local waypointDir = (waypoint.Position - myPosition)
                    waypointDir = Vector3.new(waypointDir.X, 0, waypointDir.Z)
                    
                    if waypointDir.Magnitude > 1.5 then
                        local shouldJumpWaypoint = waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump
                        applyMovement(waypointDir.Unit, shouldJumpWaypoint, dt)
                    else
                        currentWaypointIndex = currentWaypointIndex + 1
                    end
                else
                    needsJump = needsJump or shouldJumpOverObstacle(myPosition, escapeDirection)
                    applyMovement(escapeDirection, needsJump, dt)
                end
            else
                needsJump = needsJump or shouldJumpOverObstacle(myPosition, escapeDirection)
                applyMovement(escapeDirection, needsJump, dt)
                currentWaypoints = {}
            end
        else
            stopMovement()
            faceTarget(nearestPlayer)
        end
    else
        stopMovement()
        disableFacing()
        currentWaypoints = {}
    end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    if isEnabled then
        wait(0.1)
        setupBodyMovers()
    end
end)

ScreenGui.Destroying:Connect(function()
